title: coordination.md says only a refusal under the claims lock moves the run state back to released, though claim also does it for an item file save error, an interrupt and a SIGTERM
goal: kb/_self/coordination.md, Who moves it, says claim moves the run state back to released on a refusal, an item file that cannot be saved, an interrupt and a SIGTERM while it waits for the claims record's lock

run: import sys; t = open("kb/_self/coordination.md").read(); i = t.index("**Who moves it.**"); s = t[i:i + 1200]; j = s.index("released"); k = s[:j + 400]; sys.exit(0 if all(w in k for w in ("refusal", "saved", "interrupt", "SIGTERM")) else 1)
